findings.evidence: Lines 183-195 of the new file; `grep -rn "submatrix_perm" TauCeti --include="*.lean"` matches only this file, so a future consumer of matrix permutation-invariance will not find them and will duplicate them. `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/` already exists as the repo's matrix area.
findings.fix: Move both to a matrix module (e.g. a new `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Submatrix.lean` importing only Mathlib) and import it here; alternatively, if they are to stay, mark them `private` so no generic matrix API is published from a Lie-presentation module.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.submatrix_perm_trans` (line 185) and `TauCeti.submatrix_perm_symm` (line 191) are public, fully generic statements about `Matrix.submatrix` and permutations (`{α : Type*}`, `{M : Matrix B B α}`, `omit [DecidableEq B]`) with no Lie-theoretic content and no dependency on anything in this file. They are in the wrong home: they belong in an earlier, matrix-level `TauCeti/` file, not in `Algebra/Lie/Presentation/`.

findings.fix: Create the subject directory: `git mv TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Presentation/Serre.lean TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Presentation/Serre/Basic.lean` and place this file as `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Presentation/Serre/Automorphism.lean`, updating the one import. No declaration renames needed.
findings.issue: Every declaration in the module is specific to the Serre presentation (`serreDiagramAut`, `serreChevalleyInvolution`, `IsSerreSystem.perm/negSwap`, all about `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R CM`), but the file is placed flat in `Presentation/` under a generic name, at the same level as `Presentation/Basic.lean`, which is genuinely generic presentation infrastructure (`LieIdeal.mkQ`, `LieIdeal.liftQ`, `LieHom.map_ad_pow`). The directory now has two Serre-subject files flat, and the generic module name `Automorphism.lean` is pre-empted for Serre-only content.

summary: Two generic matrix lemmas with no Lie content are published from a Lie-presentation module, and the new module is entirely Serre-specific while named and placed as a generic sibling of the generic Presentation/Basic.lean. The single import is correct.
